question: A, B, C, D, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.T sits to the immediate right of D. Only three people sit between T and S when counted from the left of T. Only three people sit between D and C. A sits to the immediate right of R. How many people sit between B and R when counted from the left of R?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

T sits to the immediate right of D. Only three people sit between T and S when counted from the left of T.

Only three people sit between D and C. A sits to the immediate right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fa1f48a6cf91a1f8715895a921db7bbb2c8fe243b11462b160ab66e86da1e66.png] 

Thus, Only two sit between B and R when counted from the left of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
